name: C4D Plugin Manager
author: coffee4dev

sections.description:
This plugin relies on Redux Framework and create a group options and admin page interface for other plugins can manage option in one place.

This version is testing for C4D’s plugins only.

Arbitrary section 1
sections.changelog:
3.1.0

  • Updated: Redux Framework 4.5.16, which removes PHP 8.4 deprecation notices.
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1 and PHP 8.4.
  • Fixed: warning from defining the plugin URL constant twice.
  • Fixed: WordPress 6.7+ notice “Translation loading was triggered too early” when other C4D plugins add their settings.
  • Updated: plugin links point to the support forum and reviews.

3.0.3

  • Update: check and remove deprecated functions

3.0.2

  • Update: redux framework v4

3.0.1

  • Update: update detail link

3.0.0

  • Update: redux framework
